bundle.shortDescription: Open-source control software for the Epomaker / Ajazz AK820 Pro keyboard
bundle.longDescription: AJAZZ macOS is a clean, macOS-first replacement for the official Windows-only Epomaker / Ajazz tool. Manage lighting, remap any key, record macros, paint per-key RGB, and upload TFT animations — all via a native Tauri shell over a reverse-engineered HID protocol.
